notes.problem: Weather chip next to the sun icon. Limpo means clean, not clear sky.
Stat is elapsed seconds (playSec + s). Hora means clock hour.
Pond cross-section rendered as a lake. lago is lake, not pond.
notes.fix: Simulação de micróbios — 100 espécies + vírus. Corte da lagoa.

notes.problem: Always-on goal says Diviértete (have fun, divertirse). English Divide and the divide glossary are not there. Caps meaning and glossary.
Elapsed seconds labeled as a clock hour.
Death title is the noun extinction, not the state extinct.
OTRA VEZ is only again, vague on the death/pause button.
बाँटो is share/distribute. Cell division elsewhere in this file is विभाजन. Glossary divide is missing on the action button.
Same share-verb on the short HUD label. No shorter divide form was supplied.
Goal line बाँटो reads as share: 1/3, not divide. Inconsistent with the विभाजन toasts.
तालाब का कटाव means erosion of the pond, not a cross-section.
notes.fix: सूक्ष्मजीव सिमुलेशन — 100 प्रजातियाँ + वायरस। तालाब का काट।

notes.problem: से is the postposition from, not seconds. ठहराव 3 से reads as a halt from 3, not a cooldown.
पट्टियाँ means bandages/strips, not health bars.
जारी is the state ongoing, not a resume command. Pause-screen button.
बंद is closed/off, not the close command. Informal तुम is used in the toasts.
विलुप्ति is the noun extinction, not the extinct state on the death title.
d is not a seconds unit. jeda 3 d can be read as 3 days. detik is dtk.
Makan is the imperative/infinitive Eat, same as the button, not the past confirmation Ate.
English label is Cleaners (fungi). Pengurai means decomposers, a different player-facing word.
SÜR is drive/smear. On the pause screen it does not read as resume. Informal sen is the right register.
DURAKLAT is the command pause it. The overlay title is the status PAUSED.
TÜKENDİ means depleted/used up, not extinct. Death title.
Yenildi is read as was defeated, not was eaten. Eat glossary is YE/Yedin elsewhere; this death cause breaks it.
NASIL OYNANIR is 13 characters on a menu button (English HOW TO PLAY is 11). May wrap at 390px.
Göl is a lake. English is a pond cross-section.
notes.fix: Mikrop simülasyonu — 100 tür + virüs. Gölet kesiti.

notes.problem: ZU means shut/to, not the close command. Too cryptic for a button.
EINSTELLUNGEN is 13 characters. Settings button will overflow the 8-character HUD/menu budget the German pass was meant to test.
NEU means new, not restart.
Heure is clock hour. The stat is elapsed seconds.
Mangé is the same participle as the death cause Eaten, not the active Ate. Reads as you were eaten.
時刻 is clock time of day. The stat is elapsed seconds.
近づいた is past (you already approached). English is an order to get closer.
食べる側 is an unnatural calque (eating side), not the eater noun. Glossary consumer/eater should be 食べ手, matching 食べる.
Same calque, and 中くらいの食べる側 is too long for a species-filter chip.
エネルギー plus the ratio is wider than the reason chip (English energy is 6 letters). Do not swap in 元気.
